objective: Reduce cold Graphene AST-to-EHIR lowering, including nominal lookup and the large main function.
changes: Cache immutable module labels, declarations, trait names and normalized import paths without retaining AST graphs in lookup queries. Preserve import order, visibility, ambiguity and depth-bounded re-export behavior; bypass nominal identity memoization under shadowing generic binders.
Use compact module labels for repeated source identity, namespace, import-alias and plugin SDK queries; cache negative SDK lookup.

Search a short incoming-owner chain depth-first before expanding siblings in the node runtime. Keep exact visited tracking and the unchanged complete-search/ERN fallback; no layout, API or ownership-rule changes.
Add independent AST resolution contracts, native owner-search reachability and allocation regressions, and native CI execution.

validation.codec_roundtrip_stage: Final compiler with depth-first node owner search

notes: One local cold and one unchanged sample per complete compiler variant, dev profile and eight jobs. Dependency sources are preseeded and the OS page cache is retained; no debugger or regression suite runs concurrently with completed build measurements.

All workload source digests match. Baseline and compact-lookup binaries are byte-identical. The final executable changes because its native node runtime changes; all 17 owned EHIR payloads and all 17 native Encore archives remain byte-identical to the compact-lookup variant.

Both versions use exact production function bodies compiled with the established e9 seed and Clang -O3. The final compiler was relinked from the same LLVM IR with the new native runtime. This is not compiler self-host convergence or a CI timing forecast.
The first compact-index exploratory build was intentionally interrupted before completion; the subsequent complete 722.576-second intermediate and 529.243-second final builds are separate samples.

The isolated main diagnostic restores other modules and disables main module/function reuse; only its function/body timings are comparable to cold lowering. Its whole-process time includes warm semantic replay and restoration and is not a full cold build.
Nominal-event timers include generated specializations inside module body lowering. Do not add nominal-event totals to module body totals. Native_ms includes ir_emit_ms.
The main.enq body timer covers all functions generated while processing that module; the final main() function itself takes 26002 ms.
